matched_claim: NASA discovered alien civilization and underground cities on Mars
summary: Images from NASA's Curiosity and Perseverance rovers show geological formations, not extraterrestrial structures or civilizations.

matched_claim: Drinking boiled garlic water with lemon cures all stages of cancer within 48 hours
summary: Medical oncologists and the American Cancer Society emphasize there is no scientific evidence that garlic water cures cancer.

matched_claim: The Reserve Bank of India has banned all 500 rupee banknotes starting midnight
summary: The RBI confirmed that 500 rupee currency notes remain completely legal tender and no demonetization circular was issued.

matched_claim: ISRO launched the Aditya-L1 solar observatory mission successfully
summary: India's space research organisation ISRO successfully placed Aditya-L1 into orbit toward the Sun-Earth L1 Lagrange point.

matched_claim: Queen Elizabeth II is the current reigning monarch of the United Kingdom
summary: Queen Elizabeth II passed away on September 8, 2022. King Charles III succeeded to the British throne.

matched_claim: Crime increased 200 percent in regional city
summary: While the mathematical percentage represents a jump from 1 case to 3 cases, presenting this as an unprecedented crime surge without baseline numbers is contextually misleading.
